name: kibbles
description: Kibbles the frog's heads-up display above the Claude Code prompt (weekly and 5-hour limits by day, task progress and timer, tokens and context, helpers in colour), a built-in token saver that condenses noisy tool output, skips unchanged re-reads and keeps replies terse, and a model router that runs each part of a task on the cheapest model that fits (Haiku for easy work, Sonnet for routine coding) so your limits last longer.
